draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.13, the 114th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 8th of 21 at TE. He went 73rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (114th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (96th percentile), vertical jump (88th percentile). College production: 261 receiving yards in 2025, 17th of 21 TEs in his class with stats.
